name: Anaheim Spanish SDA
notes: Despensa/food pantry hours listed as Wednesdays 6-9pm across freefood.org / homelessshelterdirectory listings (also open Fri 7-9pm and Sat for services). Not confirmed on the church's own site; medium confidence. CAPOC partner. (714) 956-2726.

name: Emmanuel Spanish SDA Church
notes: WhyHunger structured listing: 'Saturday: Every first Saturday 1:00 PM - 2:00 PM' at 1520 S Lewis St. CAPOC partner. (714) 943-5768.

name: Higher Ground Youth & Family Services
notes: AUHSD (Anaheim Union HS District) family-resources page: 'Every Friday, 10:00 am to 11:00 am', free food, curbside + walk-ups welcome. That listing gives address 1413 E Broadway vs input 1535 E Broadway (same organization/campus). Org's own site/FB do not restate the schedule; medium confidence. (714) 833-5087.

name: Knott Avenue Christian Church
notes: Two directory sources (freefood.org and foodpantries.org) agree on Thursday 1:30-3:30 PM. Some listings show a slightly shorter/biweekly window (e.g., Thu 12-1 PM drive-thru 'until food runs out'); all agree the day is Thursday. Recommend calling 714-527-5195 to confirm.

name: Crossroads Multinational Church of the Nazarene
notes: Free groceries every Sunday 8:30-9:30 AM, no requirements. Consistent across multiple food-bank guides (Cerritos College CalWORKs guide, LA Best Babies guide). Source documents date to 2021 so confidence lowered; recommend confirming at (562) 809-4143 / 505-1154.

name: Calvary Chapel WestGrove/Shining Light
notes: Calvary Chapel Westgrove 'Bread of Life' food pantry is open Thu & Fri 3:00-4:30 PM (photo ID required, any city). Confirmed by two directories (foodpantries.org and feedam.org/resource/200620). Separately, the 'Shining Light' ministry serves a MONTHLY hot meal on Mondays (~6-8:30 PM at Atlantis/Garden Grove Park) - not a specific weekly pantry, so schedule above reflects the Bread of Life pantry.

name: Saturated In His Love
notes: Drive-through/walk-up free-choice food distribution 1st & 3rd Wednesday of each month at 11:00 AM, held at Saint Olaf Lutheran Church, 12432 9th St. Org site states 11 AM start; end time not specified so '1 PM' is an approximate close-off - confirm exact end. Confirmed on organization's own website.

name: Anselm Episcopal Church
notes: St. Anselm of Canterbury Episcopal Church, 13091 Galway St. Groceries handed out Saturday mornings ~8-11 AM per aggregated listing/search summary; could not directly confirm on the church's own site or an authoritative page, so confidence is low. Recommend calling (714) 537-0604 to verify.

name: United Martial Artists For Christ/WestGrove Calvary
notes: Site at 12832 Knott is Calvary Chapel WestGrove; runs the 'Bread of Life' food pantry Thursday & Friday 3:00-4:30 PM (photo ID required, no residency restriction). A separate listing suggested Mon-Thu 9 AM-12 PM (dry foods, once/month); the foodpantries.org detail page (Thu/Fri 3-4:30) is more specific. Hours may change - verify at (714) 321-4343.

name: Families Forward
scheduleText: Monday 9 AM-2 PM, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday 10 AM-3 PM
notes: Community Market (food pantry) at 8 Thomas, Irvine. BY APPOINTMENT ONLY - no walk-ins; call (949) 552-2727. Households can return no sooner than 14 days after last visit. Days/hours are specific and recurring, hence found, but appointment required.

name: Transitions in Motherhood
notes: Free distribution (diapers, wipes, clothing, food) 3rd Saturday of each month, 11am-1pm, at 4111 Katella Ave, Los Alamitos. All welcome. Confirmed via City of Los Alamitos community calendar.

name: CREER Communidad Y Familia
notes: Food pantry provides food Tuesdays 11 AM-2 PM at Stonefield Park, San Juan Capistrano (org address 31322 Camino Capistrano). Source is CREER's Alignable food-pantry listing; not cross-confirmed on their own site, hence medium confidence.

name: Focus North America
notes: FOCUS Orange County food pantry, 2737 S. Croddy Way Suite D (entry at rear of building). Also serves a local youth shelter. Otherwise by appointment.

name: SDA Broadway Spanish
notes: 7th Day Adventist Church pantry at 1314 N. Broadway (phone 714-543-3595 matches input). Walk-ins accepted. Listing: 'Every 2nd and 4th Wednesday of the Month 6:30 p.m. - 7:00 p.m.'

name: Serve The People
notes: Confirmed by org site and City of Santa Ana food page: 1st & 3rd Saturday monthly, 4:00-7:00 AM. Free grocery bag + produce; no appointment/pre-registration required. 1206 E. 17th St.

name: Templo Getsemani Assemblies of God
notes: WhyHunger listing for 4822 Hazard Ave shows food pantry Thursday 11 AM-noon and Sunday 1 PM. Only Thursday has a complete time range; Sunday 1 PM lacks an end time so not included in scheduleText. Recommend calling 714-767-2283 to confirm.

name: Polycarp Family Support Center
notes: St. Vincent de Paul food pantry at St. Polycarp Catholic Church (8100 Chapman Ave). M/W/F 9am-12pm confirmed by two independent listings (homelessshelterdirectory.org and foodpantries/Yelp-derived listing). Eligibility note: one source states it serves Westminster residents only - verify eligibility by phone (714) 821-7672.

name: The Seva Collective
notes: Drive-thru food pantry on 1st & 3rd Saturday of the month, 9-11:30 AM, held at Villa Fundamental Intermediate School, 1441 E. Chestnut Ave, Santa Ana (NOT the Tustin office address in the input). Day (1st & 3rd Sat) is corroborated across multiple sources; some older listings show earlier start times (4-7am/5-8am) but 2025-2026 City of Santa Ana listing gives 9-11:30 AM.
